figurative_meaning_en: to narrowly escape or survive by a slim margin
similar_in_english: by the skin of one's teeth
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় কেঁদে বাঁচলাম, শেষ মুহূর্তে উত্তর লিখলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: He narrowly escaped the fire disaster.
I barely passed the exam, writing the answer at the last moment.
note: This idiom reflects the emotional intensity in Bengali expressions of relief after peril.
